data.name: StudyBud
data.description: Submitted to Hack to School (Best Use of Google Cloud [GC] prize). A Discord bot that uses GC to store documents/assignments and GC Vision to scan pdfs and images.

data.name: Youtube-Sumarizr
data.description: Submitted to PeddieHacks 2022 ($1000-cash Passion Prize and Best Education Track). This project allows users (intended to be students or teachers) to get auto-chapters or summaries of any youtube video. They can then choose to ask a ML bot questions about these chapters and get answers. This allows students to absorb content fast and easily.

data.name: Village Volunteer
data.description: A mobile app and a Figma-extended prototype that helps the elderly to connect with young people that want to do daily chores for free or a cheap tip fee.

data.name: PetMe: Augmented Reality App
data.description: An app that allows pet lovers to adopt injured/unwanted animals from vendors. They can view the animal in 3D to choose the animal they want. Won Best use of SQL in a hackathon.

languages.name: ARKit and RealityKit on Mobile with Swift

data.name: Hackathon-er's Hall of Fame
data.description: A Web3 mobile app using a flask server. Hackathon organizers can interact with a WhatsApp bot that creates an NFT of badges on the DeSo blockchain and distributes it to hackathon participants who earned it!

data.name: Trash-ure Map
data.description: Won First Place in FiveHacks, Second Place in MergeHacks and Data Grind Hacks. A social media app for litter. Users post litter they've found online. Google Cloud Vision identifies the product (such as a Coca-cola can) and stores it in the database along with the location it is found. A crowdmap of the found data in respective regions is publicly provided, with the intention of being proof of litter and to hold companies like Coca-cola accountable for their litter.

featuredProjects.name: Worktime Tracker
featuredProjects.description: Created during the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. A worktime tracking app for employees of the client that saved 3+ days/month of the client's time. The project was also submitted as the Internal Assessment for my International Baccalaureate Computer Science course (received a score of 7 over 7).
